description: This Python source file provides utility functions and classes for processing audio files, including handling various input types, computing file hashes, and extracting audio duration. It is used within the litellm project for transcription-related functionalities.

classes.name: ProcessedAudioFile
classes.description: Data class representing a processed audio file with content, filename, and MIME type.

methods.name: process_audio_file
methods.description: Processes various input types of audio files into a structured ProcessedAudioFile object.

methods.name: get_audio_file_name
methods.description: Retrieves the filename from a file-like object or returns its string representation.

methods.name: get_audio_file_content_hash
methods.description: Computes a SHA-256 hash of the audio file content or filename for caching purposes.

methods.name: get_audio_file_for_health_check
methods.description: Provides an audio file for health check purposes, loading 'audio_health_check.wav' from the current directory.

methods.name: calculate_request_duration
methods.description: Calculates the duration of an audio file in seconds using the soundfile library, if available.
